tasks.short: Discuss the paving design with the client

steps.what: Review the proposed paving design and physical samples
Discuss paving appearance, practical constraints and client preferences

tasks.design: Keep design discussion and sample comparison with the paver and client. The existing plan in {DOCS} supplies the reference; a template or search view does not remove the need to examine its geometry, explain practical constraints and understand preferences.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is a design conversation grounded in actual materials and the site.
tasks.enabler_now: No change to these operations is established by this task.
tasks.still_hard: Colour, pattern, drainage and budget compromises need shared understanding.
tasks.human_edge: The paver explains the consequences of the client's preferences using real samples.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in this discussion boundary.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: paving design discussions use plans and material samples and rely on direct clarification of preferences.

assumptions: Boundary is discussing an already-proposed design. Original layout design and setting-out calculations are counted under the separate layout task, not silently moved to the client or a designer.

The existing plan's producer is the paver or project designer; it supplies pattern, dimensions, proposed material and joint direction. s1 includes retrieving and reading it, checking samples and manually clarifying missing details. No structured extraction is assumed.

Before choosing zero, separate plan review from the conversation and inspect document templates, catalogue lookup, changes, reports and sends. No repeated catalogue retrieval, formal written revision or dispatch is established in this discussion-only boundary; templates do not shorten the retained review. If an actual change sketch, written advice or follow-up is part of today's discussion, add that real work and reassess rather than create a new discussion log.
No technology is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero. Shares are provisional model estimates and s2 is the paver's time only, excluding the client's separate effort.
unknowns: Whether today's discussion routinely produces a revised sketch or written follow-up
research_questions: Observe a client design meeting and separately time any actual sketch revision or message

incremental.description: No new system, capture or maintenance is introduced in this conversation boundary.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Plan and sample review plus direct discussion remain fully retained. No digital operation with demonstrated removable time is established; actual written revisions would require a wider graph.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design the paver pattern and mark joint and stringline references

steps.what: Measure the paving area, levels and reference edges
Design the paver installation layout pattern
Calculate repeating joint offsets and stringline reference coordinates
Check references against site geometry and revise exceptions
Create directional markings for joints and stringlines on site

tasks.design: Test the existing drawing and setting-out software in {OTHER} for native pattern arrays and coordinate calculations. The paver measures and chooses the pattern, checks all calculated references, then creates the actual markings by hand; no digital controller or automated site marking is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated modular joint and stringline offsets are calculated individually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native drawing arrays can repeat a chosen module against verified dimensions.
tasks.still_hard: Irregular edges, drainage, cutting constraints and site discrepancies require experienced layout choices.
tasks.human_edge: The paver recognises an attractive but unbuildable pattern and corrects the setting-out on site.
tasks.altitude: The paver retains pattern selection and physical setting-out authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: drawing software can repeat modular layouts and calculate coordinates; this digest supplies no paving-specific measured saving.

assumptions: Boundary includes layout design through physical directional markings, not installing or ordering units. OTHER is the existing drawing/setting-out software category, not an assumed new digital site survey.

The paver produces area dimensions, reference origin, edge geometry, paver module dimensions, joint width and required orientation in s1-s2, including manual capture and entry. Missing or inconsistent dimensions trigger remeasurement within retained s1 and revision in s4; no free structured-input producer is assumed.

Try native arrays and coordinate tools before custom code. s3's 20 points are explicit repeated arithmetic only. s4 retains full dimensional checking, edge exceptions, manual coordinate repair and ordinary saving. More repair than this allowance requires a lower estimate.

No separate record, report or send is invented. The layout and physical markings are the task's actual outputs; author saves have no approval gate or saving. Physical measurement and marking stay fully retained.
Shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates, not observed contractor figures.
unknowns: Existing software and manual arithmetic effort
Frequency of curved boundaries and incompatible dimensional inputs
research_questions: Can the native array retain the correct joint allowance and reference origin?
How many calculated references need manual correction on an irregular site?

already_counted.description: Measurement and input capture plus complete dimensional checking and coordinate repair.

incremental.description: Maintain paver module presets and test units and origins after software changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 20 repeated calculation points less 1.2 upkeep. Conservative curved boundary requires manual edge and orientation calculations, leaving only four points of straight interior joint offsets reusable: 4 minus 1.2 = 2.8. Site marking does not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A paver who retains client discussion, design choice and physical markings while using checked calculations for repeating references.
skills_to_grow: Validate modular drawing presets and units
Check calculated references against site geometry
role.ambitious_version: Use dependable setting-out calculations without reducing the time needed to understand the client or mark the real site.
